description: This file contains a series of shell script tests for verifying the behavior of 'git archive' with various attributes, pathspecs, and attributes related to Git worktrees. It includes setup of repositories, attributes files, and assertions about file existence and content within created archives.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success for the provided commands.

methods.name: test_expect_exists
methods.description: Checks if a given file exists.

methods.name: test_expect_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given file is missing.

methods.name: extract_tar_to_dir
methods.description: Extracts a tar archive into a specified directory.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Signals the end of the test sequence.
